target_customer: Private equity firms and corporate acquirers seeking buy-side deal sourcing
problem: Acquirers struggle to find and approach off-market targets; Thornwick runs outreach on their behalf using a proprietary dataset.
business_model: Advisory fees for buy-side M&A sourcing, paired with Revi deal origination software
product_category: M&A advisory and deal origination software

founders.name: Benjamin McKinzey
founders.background_notes: Technical flags follow the site's statement that the team is engineers by background.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly data aggregation and outreach tooling; the hard part is data quality and relationships rather than engineering.

defensibility.rationale: A claimed two year proprietary acquirer and target dataset gives some edge, but advisory work is relationship based and replicable by banks.

market_need_then: Buy-side sourcing is a paid service by boutique advisers; the company claims 7 of the top 15 PE firms by AUM and over 150 active acquirers as clients (self reported).

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand; the name reads as a traditional advisory firm.

outcome_analysis: Thornwick sells buy-side M&A advisory and surfaces its Revi product, with self reported clients including most of the largest private equity firms. Revi's first version dates to September 2023 per YC, so the company predates the batch. No funding, exit or failure is documented, so the trajectory is unknown.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125K seed with locked details; single aggregator so unverified and not recorded. Whether Revi and Thornwick are one company under two names is not clearly stated; the YC page features Revi. Client numbers differ between YC page (150+) and site (100+). No dated competitor sources found. Competition list empty: no sources dated near the batch were found.
